page.layout: One page of text. Running head top left, page number top right. Below, a heading, then a list of Syriac names with Latin equivalents in two columns, a second heading, and a second list of Persian names with Latin equivalents.

main_text.head: Menses Syriaci. v. I. I. c.12.
Menses Persici. v. I.I. c.II.

page.notes: The Syriac and Persian script is printed in Arabic-type letters that I cannot reliably read letter by letter at this scan resolution, so those words are marked illegible. The Latin equivalents are clear. Faint show-through and stains from the other side of the leaf, and the digitiser's watermark at the lower right, are left out. The page number is printed with an old-style figure; it is given as 175. The Latin forms "Thifhrin" and "Nifan" are printed with long s and are given here with plain s.
